transcript.answer:
ADR-002 (settled 2026-09-25) decided this after PR #261 review comment 4098626654 proposed dropping the card and letting the model answer in free text. Delivery status is always rendered as a deterministic card with `suppressAssistantResponse: true`. The model never phrases a delivery time, ETA or status in prose. The ADR gives three reasons, plus a fourth point about the thumbs-up KPI:
1. The card-rate KPI (SC-006, card rate ≥ 90% by 2026-Q4) counts cards. A prose answer has no measurable denominator, so the KPI can only be measured if the answer is always a card.
2. EU AI Act and danish-review compliance. The data-flow record and the `docs/danish-review.md` rows promise that the customer reads delivery status verbatim from the TMS. A paraphrased ETA is the one hallucination the pilot cannot afford.
3. FR-043 of support-agent-tms-tools is being amended specifically to permit a deterministic-render tool. Without the card the amendment has no justification and the prohibition would stand.
4. The thumbs-up KPI (SC-007, ≥ 80% by 2026-Q4) also depends on the card. Ratings attach to card turns, and a prose answer produces no rating.
The not-found card is deterministic for the same reason: the model cannot invent a shipment it did not fetch.

judgements.reason: The answer covers the card-rate KPI (SC-006, ≥90% by 2026-Q4) as the denominator, verbatim TMS status with paraphrased ETA as the unaffordable hallucination, and the free-text proposal on PR #261 rejected 2026-09-25; the extra points do not contradict the gold.
